reuse.why: Extends the existing shared link guard used by every provider link function and extracts the unlink field-clearing from unlinkAccount into clearAccountBankLink, so both unlink paths share it.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the only overlap is the new 'account not found' check in the guard, which repeats the per-provider not-found check that runs later.

placement.why: The replace rule sits in the shared link guard in accounts/app.ts next to the unlink helper; a guard that now also mutates (renamed claimBankAccountLink) mixes validation with a side effect, but stays in the right module.

scope.why: Focused on the flag, plus a small extra behaviour change (throwing early when upgradingId is not found) that is needed so the holder is not unlinked before a failing link.

maintainability.why: One flag threaded through the base params into one guard and one shared unlink helper is easy to own; the unlink happens before the link itself without a transaction, which a maintainer may want revisited.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared guard and the extracted clearAccountBankLink rather than going around unlinkAccount's logic.

disguised_duplication.where: The early not-found check duplicates the later per-provider check openly; nothing is reshaped to hide a copy.
